stb_image.h by Sean Barrett (https://github.com/nothings/stb), MIT or public
domain at your choice; the full text is at the end of the header. Vellum
uses it for PNG covers only (STBI_ONLY_PNG).

stb_truetype.h (v1.26), same author and licence, renders the fonts that are
not pre-rendered (vellum/font_raster.h).
